subject: Onsite week conflict — propose recorded demo + live Q&A or alternate windows
messages:
From: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@nimblecare.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: solutions@nimblecare.com
Date: 2027-04-10T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Onsite week — demo planning (April 26)

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for lining up the Redwood demo for our field week. The team confirmed an onsite visit the week of April 26 and I'd love to keep the live walkthrough if possible. Right now our travel windows are pretty tight: customer interviews on Apr 26–27 and a partner dinner night of Apr 27. The only slot the execs have for a 45–60 minute product walkthrough is Apr 26 between 11:30–13:00 local.

Would that work for you? If not, we can move to a recorded session + live Q&A later in the same week — whichever is easier for your team. Also attaching a short agenda of the goals we have for the session (audience = product + ops + a security lead).

Appreciate the flexibility — Ethan
Senior Program Manager
NimbleCare

Attachment: nimblecare-demo-brief.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@nimblecare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-10T18:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite week — demo planning (April 26)

Ethan — thanks for the agenda and the heads-up. 11:30–13:00 on Apr 26 is possible but tight for our SEs given another onsite earlier that morning. Two quick options: 

- We hold a live 45-minute walkthrough on Apr 26 at 11:30 with an abbreviated architecture deep-dive (we'll focus on serving/runtime and security posture) — Marissa will lead the security section; Dev will cover latency/cost tuning.
- Or we record the full 60-minute demo (we'll send a polished recording + short chapter markers) and do a 30-minute live Q&A on Apr 28 so your execs can watch on travel days.

If you confirm the live slot, we can treat Apr 26 as the default and I'll book the invites. If you think travel will make attendance unreliable, the recorded+Q&A is probably lower risk.

Also attaching our updated demo agenda (short).

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf (PDF, 95KB)

From: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@nimblecare.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: solutions@nimblecare.com
Date: 2027-04-11T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite week — demo planning (April 26)

Neha — quick update: travel logistics changed overnight. Our director realized they'll have a stopover with a late flight into town on Apr 26 and won't be available until Apr 28. That wipes out the 11:30 slot. Sorry for the last-minute shift.

Given that, we prefer the recorded demo + live Q&A on Apr 28 (30 minutes) so the director can watch the recording en route and join for the Q&A. Could you: 

1) Send the recorded demo by Apr 26 EOD (so people can watch on the 27th).
2) Propose two 30-minute Q&A windows on Apr 28 (PST) — preferably morning and late-afternoon for cross-site coverage.

If there's any way to keep some portion live on Apr 26, let me know, but otherwise recorded+Q&A is our pick.

Thanks — Ethan

Subject: Re: Onsite week — demo planning (April 26)

Thanks for the update, Ethan — totally makes sense. We'll switch to the recorded + live Q&A plan. Action items on our side: 

- We'll record a 60-minute demo with chapters (overview, serving/runtime, security, cost controls, rollouts) and upload it by Apr 26 EOD. Attachment will be a short playbook (proposed-async-playbook.docx) that outlines viewing guidance and Q&A topics.
- For Apr 28 Q&A windows (PST): we can do 10:00–10:30 and 15:30–16:00. If your cross-site folks need a different band, tell us and we can adjust.
- Marissa will prepare a 10-minute security summary to drop into the recording and be available live for Q&A. Dev will join the Q&A for any latency/cost questions.

Please confirm which Q&A slot you prefer and I'll send calendar invites. Also telling my team to hold Apr 26 morning in case anything slips back to live, but otherwise we won't double-book.

Best,
Neha

Appreciate the flexibility — looking forward to the recording.

Ethan
